findings.description: The wrapper now reuses one shared statistics dict across calls and clears it on every invocation, so concurrent calls to the same decorated coroutine overwrite each other's statistics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: two overlapping awaits of the same decorated async function. Mechanism: the second call runs stats.clear() on the dict that the first call's copy also writes to, so the first call's attempt_number and other fields are reset or replaced by the second call's values. Previously each call got a fresh dict. Impact: callers reading wrapped_f.statistics or per-call stats during concurrent use see wrong or mixed values.
